req.title: Index renders even with zero posts
req.statement: The system shall render the index page with 'No posts' or empty state when the post table is empty.
triggers: index renders even with zero posts

doc.reasoning: R-FLASKR-037 requires that GET / returns HTTP 2xx even when the post table is empty. Three tests are designed: (1) positive — empty DB, verify 200 and empty posts list renders without error; (2) negative — verify that with posts present the page still returns 200 but contains post content (confirming the empty-state path is distinct from the populated path); (3) boundary — exactly zero posts (BVA at the boundary of 0 vs 1 post), confirming the transition from empty to non-empty state. Each test uses an isolated temp DB, initialises schema, and drives the Flask test client in-process. Assertions are exact-value to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_index_empty_db_returns_200
preconditions: Database is initialised with schema but zero rows in post table
actions: Send GET / with an empty post table
expected: Response body does not contain any post title from the seed data
trace: R-FLASKR-037: index renders even with zero posts -> HTTP 2xx
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import init_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix='.sqlite')
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    init_db()
    # Delete all posts to guarantee empty state
    from flaskr.db import get_db
    db = get_db()
    db.execute('DELETE FROM post')
    db.commit()

client = app.test_client()

def test_index_empty_db_returns_200():
    r = client.get('/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    # No post titles from seed data should appear
    assert b'Pulse ember signal' not in r.data
    assert b'Pillow delta willow' not in r.data

test_index_empty_db_returns_200()
os.unlink(path)

tests.name: test_index_boundary_zero_to_one_post
preconditions: Post table starts with zero rows (boundary at 0)
actions: Send GET / with zero posts — record status and body
Send GET / again — record status and body
expected: With zero posts: response does not contain the inserted post title
With one post: response contains the inserted post title
trace: R-FLASKR-037: BVA at boundary 0 posts (must render) and 1 post (must also render with content)
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import init_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix='.sqlite')
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    init_db()
    from flaskr.db import get_db
    db = get_db()
    db.execute('DELETE FROM post')
    db.execute('DELETE FROM user')
    db.commit()

client = app.test_client()

def test_index_boundary_zero_to_one_post():
    # Boundary: 0 posts
    r0 = client.get('/')
    assert r0.status_code == 200
    assert b'Boundary Post Title' not in r0.data

    # Transition: insert exactly 1 post
    with app.app_context():
        from flaskr.db import get_db
        db = get_db()
        db.execute("INSERT INTO user (id,username,password) VALUES (1,'Rahul','x')")
        db.execute("INSERT INTO post (id,author_id,created,title,body) VALUES (1,1,'2025-01-01 00:00:00','Boundary Post Title','Body text')")
        db.commit()

    # Boundary: 1 post
    r1 = client.get('/')
    assert r1.status_code == 200
    assert b'Boundary Post Title' in r1.data

test_index_boundary_zero_to_one_post()
os.unlink(path)

tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import init_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix='.sqlite')
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    init_db()
    from flaskr.db import get_db
    db = get_db()
    db.execute('DELETE FROM post')
    db.commit()

client = app.test_client()

def test_index_empty_db_response_is_html():
    r = client.get('/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
    assert 'text/html' in ct
    assert len(r.data) > 0
    # Must not be a 4xx or 5xx error page
    assert b'500' not in r.data[:200]
    assert b'404' not in r.data[:200]

test_index_empty_db_response_is_html()
os.unlink(path)
